_notes: PHASE-106 v1 seed;  (PHASE-107) adds `core` (true = always-on, tenant cannot disable in the field picker; absent = false) and maps the five response-driven scalars (attribution_setting, canvas_avg_view_percent/_time, cost_per_estimated_ad_recallers, full_view_impressions) with types matching what ES dynamic mapping already produced on live daily indices. action_metric.action_type is stored DOT-STRIPPED (reformat_insights replaces '.' with '_'), e.g. offsite_conversion_fb_pixel_purchase; the true FB action_type has a dot (offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase). v1 only requests the parent ('actions'/'cost_per_action_type') and takes the response as-is, so this is harmless; the picker phase (107) must recover the true dotted value before matching on action_type. aggregation: sum=additive numeric, none=non-additive numeric (FB-deduped), ratio=computed, dimension=group-by/label, null=unknown (unmapped/dynamic or a request-only parent).
